title: Aureline M5 sensitivity-sharing-banner component
description: Documents the controlled vocabulary the sensitivity-sharing-banner family binds inside the frozen M5 experiment-component matrix (schemas/ui/m5-experiment-component-matrix.schema.json). A sensitivity / sharing banner names how sensitive a result or dataset is and what a share will actually include so a banner never leaves sensitivity implicit before a share and never exposes raw production-like data by default. The Rust validator in crates/aureline-notebook is the authoritative gate; this schema documents the family's shape.
